title: Russia allows Bitcoin trading as sanctioned Moscow Exchange prepares December launch
summary: From Nov. 22, Russian exchanges can begin trading Bitcoin once the central bank approves the rules, but customers still can't use it to pay for anything. Moscow Exchange plans a Dec. 1 pilot through a US-sanctioned clearinghouse, with ordinary investors limited to 300,000 rubles in annual purchases per intermediary.
